question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure: **

The ministers were being briefed about the situation by the intelligence officers.

options.text: The intelligence officers briefed the ministers about the situation.
The intelligence officers had briefed the ministers.
The ministers were briefed by the intelligence officers.
The intelligence officers were briefing the ministers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: In the passive voice, the subject receives the action, while in the active voice, the subject performs the action.
 
• Original sentence in passive voice: "The ministers were being briefed about the situation by the intelligence officers."
 
• To convert it to active voice, make the doer of the action ("the intelligence officers") the subject of the sentence.
 
• The correct active voice sentence is: "The intelligence officers were briefing the ministers about the situation."
 
• This retains the meaning and tense of the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The intelligence officers were briefing the ministers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The intelligence officers briefed the ministers about the situation." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 2: **"The intelligence officers had briefed the ministers." – Incorrect tense (past perfect instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"The ministers were briefed by the intelligence officers." – This is still in passive voice.
 
• **Option 4: **"The intelligence officers were briefing the ministers." – Correct active voice conversion, matching the original tense.
